newsitem.title: USA: VocalTec supplies internet phone service to Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: VocalTec supplies internet phone service to Taiwan.

text.p: Internet telephony company VocalTec Ltd on Friday said Taiwan Telecommunication Network Services Co Ltd has selected VocalTec products for publicly available Internet telephony service between Taiwan and the United States.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
Privately held Taiwan Telecom will work through its U.S. partner, Biztrans Technology of Springfield, Va., to install and operate the VocalTec Telephony Gateways.

VocalTec said it's Internet Telephony Gateway connects the Internet to local telephone lines. The VocalTec Telephony Gateway routes calls through the Internet and out via the public switched telephone network.
Taiwan Telecom is the fourth national communications company to offer Internet telephony services based on VocalTec's products.
